About the shelf: The Keystone Cycle

Five Greek diaspora teenagers share a converted sponge merchant's house on Kalymnos, then go on to the places their families left: Tarpon Springs, Darwin, Sfax, Alexandria, Broome. Each of them turns up a document there first. Each book stands alone. They read richer as a cycle.
